article.title: 그래서
article.part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태

claims.summary: The Korean Basic Dictionary defines **그래서** as a word used when the preceding content is the cause, basis, or condition for what follows. This entry is limited to that relation; it does not claim that every two consecutive events are causally linked.
